blocked_reason: Root cause identified from the project MCP log: at 2026-08-20T06:37:18Z, the exact second this session id was created by /clear, Claude Code logged "excludeStalePluginClients: marking stale (removed)" for plugin-sdlc-gemini-flash-server, SIGINT-ed the inherited server process, and never spawned a replacement. The prior session in the same CLI process had a healthy server making log_telemetry calls at 05:40Z. NOT an install, build, or credential fault: dist/server.js handshakes cleanly and a healthy session at 05:10Z logs the same 7-unset-env-placeholder warning and then connects fine, falling back to ADC (~/.config/gcloud/application_default_credentials.json present, GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=ai-studies-console).
resume_action: Fully EXIT the CLI process and start a fresh `claude` in this directory. Do NOT use /clear (that is the operation that removed the server) and do NOT use --continue/--resume (a resumed session inherits the same stale-client path). Verify /mcp lists gemini-flash-server connected, then run /sdlc:brownfield and answer `resume`. Gate 0 stays approved; discovery stays cached; the write contract stays frozen.

hydrate_compat_note: status/phase mirror state/next_phase because session-hydrate.mjs readResume() keys on .status and .phase while the orchestrator writes .state and .next_phase.
